items.title: Approve the Minutes of the June 09, 2026 Meeting
Adopt the Inner Sunset Transportation Study Final Report
Allocate $22,651,000 in Prop L Funds and Allocate $1,860,572 in Prop AA Funds, with Conditions, for Ten Requests
Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the District 2 Safety Study and Implementation to Update the Project Scope, Schedule, Cost, and Funding Plan
Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2026/27 Budget and Work Program
Allocate $180,800 in Prop L Funds to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency and Appropriate $49,900 in Prop L Funds for the Central Subway North Beach Extension Study
Adopt the Geary/19th Ave Subway and Regional Connections Study Final Report

Authorize an Additional Construction Allotment for a Revised Additional Construction Allotment and Approve a Contract Amendment with GHD Inc for the Bimla Rhinehart Vista Point Pier Parking Lot Project

Award a Construction Contract to Gordon N. Ball, Inc.,; Approve a Contract Amendment with WMH Corporation; and Authorize the Executive Director to Execute Supporting and Supplemental Agreements for Treasure Island Road Improvement - Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Pathway Segment 4
Internal Accounting Report, Investment Report, and Debt Expenditure Report for the Nine Months Ending March 31, 2026
